title: NOMOS Revocation Statement
description: A detached, issuer-signed statement that one specific sealed artifact version should no longer be relied upon (NOMOS-SPEC-006 §3). Never embedded in, and never a mutation of, the artifact it revokes.

artifact_version.description: The exact version being revoked. Revocation is per-version — revoking one version says nothing about any other.

artifact_hash.description: MUST equal the seal.hash of the version named above (binding check, NOMOS-SPEC-006 §3.4). An unbound statement MUST NOT be treated as revoking a version whose hash it does not match.

reason.description: Free-text, human-readable. This document does not mandate a closed enum; a deployment needing machine-routed reasons MAY adopt its own controlled vocabulary as a documented convention.

kid.description: Key id of the ISSUER key that sealed the artifact being revoked — not a new revocation-specific key. MUST resolve to the same key that produced the artifact's own seal (NOMOS-SPEC-006 §3.5). Resolvable at /.well-known/nomos-signing-keys per NOMOS-SPEC-001 §8.4.

signature.description: base64 Ed25519 signature over JCS({ artifact_id, artifact_version, artifact_hash, reason, issued_at }) — see NOMOS-SPEC-006 §3.3. algorithm, kid, and signature itself are excluded from the signed payload.

issued_at.description: When the statement was signed. Part of the signed payload — unlike NOMOS-SPEC-004's revoked_at (an unsigned annotation on an attestation), this timestamp IS signed content. See NOMOS-SPEC-006 §1.

examples.reason: Signing key suspected compromised 2026-08-24. All versions sealed under this kid are withdrawn pending re-seal under a rotated key.
